levels.name: 起步期

levels.desc_en: No ESG management foundation established yet.

levels.name: 建置期
levels.desc: 已有部分作法，需制度化

levels.name: 管理期
levels.desc: 已有管理能力，可進一步做策略整合
levels.desc_en: Management capability in place; ready for strategy integration.

modules.title: 一般組織 ESG 基礎健檢
modules.goal: 判斷治理、合規、資料、制度等 ESG 基本體質

questions.q: 您的組織是否已有明確的 ESG 或永續負責人／負責單位？
questions.qe: Does your organization have a clear ESG / sustainability owner or responsible unit?

questions.q: 高階主管是否會定期關注 ESG、永續、社會責任或相關風險議題？
questions.qe: Do senior executives regularly engage with ESG, sustainability, social responsibility, or related risk topics?

questions.q: ESG 相關工作目前是否已有跨部門協作機制，而不只是單一人員處理？
questions.qe: Is there already a cross-functional collaboration mechanism for ESG work, rather than a single person handling it?

questions.q: 您是否清楚目前組織面對的 ESG 外部要求，例如客戶要求、供應鏈要求、揭露要求或政府政策？
questions.qe: Are you clear about the external ESG requirements your organization faces (e.g., customer, supply-chain, disclosure, or government policy requirements)?

questions.q: 您的組織是否曾回覆過客戶 ESG 問卷、供應鏈稽核或永續揭露相關需求？
questions.qe: Has your organization ever responded to customer ESG questionnaires, supply-chain audits, or sustainability disclosure requests?

questions.q: 您的組織是否已有基礎政策或規範，例如誠信經營、人權、職安、供應商要求等？
questions.qe: Does your organization have basic policies or standards in place, such as business integrity, human rights, occupational safety, or supplier requirements?

questions.q: 您是否掌握基本環境數據，例如用電、用水、廢棄物、燃料等？
questions.qe: Do you capture basic environmental data such as electricity, water, waste, and fuel consumption?

questions.q: 您是否做過碳排放盤點，或至少已知道 Scope 1、2、3 的概念與邊界？
questions.qe: Have you conducted a carbon inventory, or at least understand the concepts and boundaries of Scope 1, 2, and 3?

questions.q: 您的組織是否曾推動過具體的節能、減碳、減廢或資源效率改善行動？
questions.qe: Has your organization implemented concrete energy-saving, decarbonization, waste-reduction, or resource-efficiency initiatives?

questions.q: 您的組織是否已有員工安全、健康、教育訓練或福祉相關制度？
questions.qe: Does your organization have systems for employee safety, health, training, or wellbeing?

questions.q: 您是否追蹤人才相關指標，例如流動率、培訓時數、職災事件、滿意度等？
questions.qe: Do you track talent-related metrics such as turnover, training hours, occupational incidents, or satisfaction?

questions.q: 您的組織是否有處理申訴、職場平等、反歧視或 DEI 相關機制？
questions.qe: Does your organization have mechanisms for grievances, workplace equality, anti-discrimination, or DEI (diversity, equity, inclusion)?

questions.q: 您是否對供應商或合作夥伴有基本的道德、品質、法遵或 ESG 要求？
questions.qe: Do you set basic ethics, quality, compliance, or ESG requirements for suppliers or partners?

questions.q: 您是否曾辨識供應鏈風險，例如斷鏈、法規、勞動、人權或環境風險？
questions.qe: Have you identified supply-chain risks such as disruption, regulatory, labor, human-rights, or environmental risks?

questions.q: 當組織發生重大事件時，是否有通報、調查與改善機制？
questions.qe: When a major incident occurs, is there a mechanism for reporting, investigation, and corrective action?

questions.q: 您是否知道主要 ESG 資料應由哪個部門蒐集、更新與保存？
questions.qe: Do you know which department should collect, update, and retain the main ESG data?

questions.q: 如果客戶下週要求一份 ESG 基本資料，您的組織是否能在短時間內整理出來？
questions.qe: If a customer requested basic ESG information next week, could your organization compile it in a short time?

questions.q: ESG 目前是否已被納入預算、年度計畫、管理會議或主管 KPI 討論？
questions.qe: Is ESG already included in budgeting, annual planning, management meetings, or executive KPI discussions?

modules.title: 創價型 ESG 健檢
modules.goal: 判斷 ESG 是否已連結價值創造、商模與擴張

questions.aspect: Purpose 與 North Star 對齊
questions.q: 您的組織是否能清楚說出：我們做 ESG，不只是為了合規，而是為了創造什麼更大的價值？
questions.qe: Can your organization clearly articulate the greater value it creates through ESG beyond mere compliance?
questions.aspect_en: Purpose 與 North Star 對齊

questions.aspect: Purpose 與 North Star 對齊
questions.q: ESG 是否與組織的核心使命、品牌定位或未來成長方向有清楚連結？
questions.qe: Is ESG clearly linked to the organization's core mission, brand positioning, or future growth direction?
questions.aspect_en: Purpose 與 North Star 對齊

questions.aspect: Purpose 與 North Star 對齊
questions.q: 您的團隊是否能用一句話清楚說明自己的永續北極星願景？
questions.qe: Can your team state its sustainability north-star vision in a single sentence?
questions.aspect_en: Purpose 與 North Star 對齊

questions.aspect: 問題定義與社會痛點洞察
questions.q: 您的組織是否明確知道：自己真正想解決的是哪一個社會、環境或產業問題？
questions.qe: Does your organization clearly know which specific social, environmental, or industry problem it truly aims to solve?
questions.aspect_en: 問題定義與社會痛點洞察

questions.aspect: 問題定義與社會痛點洞察
questions.q: 您是否能清楚區分目標受益者、影響對象、客戶與利害關係人？
questions.qe: Can you clearly distinguish target beneficiaries, affected stakeholders, customers, and other stakeholders?
questions.aspect_en: 問題定義與社會痛點洞察

questions.aspect: 問題定義與社會痛點洞察
questions.q: 您是否曾驗證過：外部利害關係人真的在乎這個問題，而不只是組織自己認為重要？
questions.qe: Have you validated that external stakeholders genuinely care about this problem, not just the organization assuming it matters?
questions.aspect_en: 問題定義與社會痛點洞察

questions.aspect: 影響力設計與副作用風險
questions.q: 您的組織是否曾系統性盤點方案的一階、二階、三階影響？
questions.qe: Has your organization systematically mapped the first-, second-, and third-order impacts of its solution?
questions.aspect_en: 影響力設計與副作用風險

questions.aspect: 影響力設計與副作用風險
questions.q: 您是否評估過方案可能帶來的反效果，例如漂綠、成本轉嫁、資訊不對稱、社會排擠等？
questions.qe: Have you assessed possible side effects such as greenwashing, cost shifting, information asymmetry, or social exclusion?
questions.aspect_en: 影響力設計與副作用風險

questions.aspect: 影響力設計與副作用風險
questions.q: 在設計 ESG 行動時，是否已納入降低副作用與防漂綠機制？
questions.qe: When designing ESG actions, are safeguards against side effects and greenwashing already built in?
questions.aspect_en: 影響力設計與副作用風險

questions.q: 您是否清楚知道：誰受益、誰使用、誰決策、誰付費？
questions.qe: Do you clearly know who benefits, who uses, who decides, and who pays?

questions.q: 您的 ESG 行動是否已能帶來收入提升、客戶黏著、成本下降、品牌溢價或風險降低？
questions.qe: Do your ESG actions already drive revenue growth, customer retention, cost reduction, brand premium, or risk reduction?

questions.q: 您是否能說明 ESG 如何真正回到商業模式，而不只是外加活動？
questions.qe: Can you explain how ESG truly returns to the business model, rather than being an add-on activity?

questions.q: 您是否已把關鍵假設寫清楚，例如市場需求、採用障礙、願付價格、合作意願？
questions.qe: Have you documented key assumptions such as market demand, adoption barriers, willingness to pay, and partnership intent?

questions.q: 您是否曾用 PoC、pilot、MVP 或小規模專案驗證 ESG 解方？
questions.qe: Have you validated the ESG solution via a PoC, pilot, MVP, or small-scale project?

questions.q: 您是否能拿出一些證據，說明 ESG 已產生具體成果，例如採用率、ROI、影響指標或客戶回饋？
questions.qe: Can you present evidence that ESG has produced tangible outcomes such as adoption rate, ROI, impact metrics, or customer feedback?

questions.q: 您的組織是否已建立外部共創關係，例如客戶、供應商、學研、政府、平台夥伴？
questions.qe: Has your organization built external co-creation relationships with customers, suppliers, academia, government, or platform partners?

questions.q: 您的 ESG 解方是否能被複製到其他部門、客戶、地區或產業？
questions.qe: Can your ESG solution be replicated to other departments, customers, regions, or industries?

questions.q: 您是否已形成一個可對外說清楚的成長敘事：為何這件事不只是做好事，而是值得擴張？
questions.qe: Have you formed a clear growth narrative: why this is not just doing good, but worth scaling?

modules.title: 永續策略藍圖導入準備度
modules.goal: 判斷是否適合進入永續策略藍圖 2.0 的九張 Canvas

questions.q: 您的組織是否對「我們為何要做永續」已有內部共識？
questions.qe: Does your organization have internal consensus on why it pursues sustainability?

questions.q: 高階團隊是否願意把永續聚焦成 3–5 個重大承諾，而不是什麼都做？
questions.qe: Is the executive team willing to focus sustainability on 3–5 major commitments, rather than doing everything?

questions.q: 您的組織是否能從眾多 ESG 議題中收斂出最重要的 6–8 個優先議題？
questions.qe: Can your organization converge from many ESG topics to the 6–8 most important priority issues?

questions.q: 在判斷重要議題時，是否會同時考慮風險、商機、法規、客戶要求與利害關係人？
questions.qe: When judging material topics, do you consider risk, opportunity, regulation, customer requirements, and stakeholders together?

questions.q: 您的組織是否有能力把 ESG 議題整理成 3–5 個策略支柱？
questions.qe: Does your organization have the capability to organize ESG topics into 3–5 strategic pillars?

questions.q: 組織內部是否有條件進行跨部門策略共識與責任分工？
questions.qe: Are there conditions for cross-departmental strategy alignment and clear accountability?

questions.q: 您是否已有明確 KPI、目標值、資料來源與負責人？
questions.qe: Do you already have clear KPIs, target values, data sources, and owners?

questions.q: 您是否能區分短期 quick wins、基礎能力建設、戰略 KPI 與長期 impact KPI？
questions.qe: Can you distinguish short-term quick wins, foundational capability building, strategic KPIs, and long-term impact KPIs?

questions.q: 您目前是否已有一批可被盤點的 ESG 專案或永續行動？
questions.qe: Do you already have a set of ESG projects or sustainability actions that can be inventoried?

questions.q: 您是否會用影響力與可行性來排序專案優先順序？
questions.qe: Do you prioritize projects by impact and feasibility?

questions.q: 您的永續推動是否已需要外部夥伴共同完成，而不是只靠內部？
questions.qe: Does your sustainability push already require external partners, not just internal effort?

questions.q: 您是否有意識要把自己定位成某個永續生態系中的關鍵節點或協作中心？
questions.qe: Are you consciously positioning yourself as a key node or collaboration hub in a sustainability ecosystem?

questions.q: 您是否能清楚說明：投入什麼、做了什麼、產出什麼、帶來什麼成果、創造什麼長期影響？
questions.qe: Can you clearly state inputs, activities, outputs, outcomes, and long-term impact?

questions.q: 您的組織是否需要向董事會、投資人、客戶或主管機關證明這條因果鏈？
questions.qe: Does your organization need to prove this causal chain to the board, investors, customers, or regulators?

questions.q: 您是否已掌握主要 ESG 資料來源、資料品質、更新頻率與責任人？
questions.qe: Do you already master the main ESG data sources, data quality, update frequency, and owners?

questions.q: 您是否需要儀表板、警示機制、報告輸出或資料自動化？
questions.qe: Do you need dashboards, alerting, report output, or data automation?

questions.q: 您的組織是否需要一頁式永續藍圖，對內對外統一溝通？
questions.qe: Does your organization need a one-page sustainability blueprint for consistent internal and external communication?

questions.q: 高階主管是否願意在 60–90 天內投入完成一版永續策略藍圖？
questions.qe: Are executives willing to invest in completing a version of the sustainability strategy blueprint within 60–90 days?
